sentences.text:
Ayyub And 4 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on 12 March,
2024
Author: Krishan Pahal

Bench: Krishan Pahal
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc:44380
Court No. - 75
Case :- Criminal Misc Anticipatory Bail Application U/S 438 Cr.P.C. No. - 11336 of 2021
Applicant :- Ayyub And 4 Others

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Mohammad Zakir
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Krishan Pahal,J.
1.
None has appeared to press it for the applicants.
Learned AGA is present for the State.
Under the circumstances, I myself have perused the record.

2. The present application for anticipatory bail has been filed for protection in regard to FIR/Case Crime No. 0114 of 2021, under Sections 498A, 323, 376, 506 IPC and Section 3 and 4 of Muslim Women (Protection of Rights on Marriage) Act, 2019, P.S. Shikarpur, District Bulandshahr.
3.

entities.text: Muslim Women (Protection of Rights on Marriage) Act, 2019
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
The instant anticipatory bail application was filed in the year 2021 and none was present on behalf of applicant to press the instant anticipatory bail application on 28.01.2023, 14.03.2023,
Ayyub And 4 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on 12 March, 2024

entities.text: Ayyub And 4 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/50083603/
1 21.09.2023, 02.02.2024 and 19.02.2024 and so is the case today.

4. Learned A.G.A. has informed that in the instant anticipatory bail application the prayer has been made to grant anticipatory bail during the pendency of the investigation only and charge-sheet has already been filed, as such the instant anticipatory bail application has been rendered infructuous.
5.
As per report of Additional Sessions Judge/F.T.C. Court No.2, Bulandshahar, Final Report (charge-sheet) was submitted on 16.12.2022 and charge was framed on 10.04.2023.

entities.text: Additional Sessions Judge/F.T.C. Court No.2, Bulandshahar
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
The prosecution evidence is going on.
6.
In view of aforesaid statement so made, the application is, accordingly, dismissed as infructuous.
7. The Registrar (Compliance) is directed to communicate this order to the concerned Court/authority for necessary information and compliance, forthwith.
8. Interim protection granted, if any, stands vacated.
9. It is always open for the applicant to file a regular bail application before the court concerned in accordance to law, if required.
